description: A React component called InputPanel that provides a user interface for selecting a calculation type (derivative, integral, limit), inputting a mathematical expression, and triggering calculations via external functions. It manages user input state, validation, and invokes external calculation utilities.

methods.name: resetFields
methods.description: Resets input fields to default values.

methods.name: handleCalculate
methods.description: Handles form submission: performs validation, calls calculation, handles errors, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: getPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns placeholder text based on the selected calculation type.
